_comment: Settings for one mutation-loop run, read by profile_config.py. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored.
_schema_options: random | Autonomous Vehicle Schema | Feature Testing Schema | Strenda Schema | EnzymeML Schema
_num_steps_note: positive integer, number of mutation steps per run
_screenshots_note: true | false, capture a screenshot every step
_run_mode_options: background | watch_failures | interactive | null (null asks at the terminal)
